subquestions.prompt_template: A holiday costs R{P} now. The company predicts the cost will increase by {r}% p.a. What will it cost in {n} years?

Sarah opened a savings account at {r}% p.a., compounded quarterly. She deposited R{P} on 1 January {y1} and continued to deposit R{P} at the beginning of each quarter. Last deposit on 1 October {y2}. Calculate the accumulated amount on 1 January {y3}.
steps: This is a future value annuity due (deposits at beginning of each quarter).

subquestions.prompt_template: A loan of R{P} was granted on 28 February {y}. Monthly repayments of R{x} at {r}% p.a., compounded monthly. First payment was missed for 3 months. How many months to repay?
steps: The loan accrues interest during the missed months.
